label: Johnny Bravo
description: All hair, all muscle, and fairly sure the traffic is here to see him.
direction: Speak as a vain, swaggering muscle man with a deep, smooth, Elvis-like drawl: slow, self-adoring, punctuated by sharp karate grunts. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model not yet chosen: `voice` is the placeholder "TBD" until the voice-selection pass names one. The vanity sits on greetings, alerts and arrival; turns stay plain. The flirting is left out; the self-love is plenty.

rights.source_work: Johnny Bravo (first seen in the What a Cartoon! shorts)
rights.author: Cartoon Network, now Warner Bros. Discovery (character created by Van Partible)
rights.pd_basis: None. The series and character are in copyright and trademarked. Jeff Bennett originated the voice and is living.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, including Jeff Bennett's.

The third-party voice model to be named in `voice` (not yet chosen, hence "TBD"), which will have been uploaded by a member of the public and presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Enough time to fix my hair.
lines.start_drive_1: Whoa, mama! Let's hit the road.
lines.start_drive_2: Hey there, driver. Check out the navigator.
lines.start_drive_3: Man, I'm pretty. Pretty good at directions.
lines.start_drive_4: Do the monkey with me! After we park.
lines.start_drive_5: Hoo! Hah! Huh! Johnny's ready to roll.
lines.start_drive_6: Careful with the wind. This hair took all morning.
lines.start_drive_7: Johnny Bravo's the name. Looking good's the game.
lines.start_drive_8: Buckle up. These muscles need protecting.
lines.start_drive_9: Alright, let's cruise. Momma wants me home by six.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. I meant to do that. Hoo, hah!
lines.arrived: We're here! Man, I'm good. And pretty.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Whoa, mama, that's a lot.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. They all stopped to look at me.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Careful. Not the hair.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Whoa, mama! Watch it.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Slow down. Give them my good side.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop, and strike a pose.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Is being this pretty a crime?
lines.reroute_chime: Whoa, missed it. Even perfection takes a detour.
